news.title: U.S. to Curb China's Access to AI Chips as Trump Heads to Asia
news.summary: A new Commerce Department rule makes top-tier AI chips bound for data centers in five Southeast Asian countries and Brazil subject to export licenses, days before a Trump–Xi meeting.
news.why: Anyone shipping advanced GPUs or servers through Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia or Brazil should expect licensing delays and re-check end-use paperwork.

news.title: Labor Strike Shuts Down Dozens of Bangladesh Garment Factories
news.summary: Close to 150 apparel plants around Dhaka have halted as workers demand that the monthly minimum wage more than double, with a government wage panel due to report by month-end.
news.why: Apparel importers should flag spring orders from Savar, Ashulia and Gazipur for possible slippage and budget for higher unit costs if wages rise.

news.title: Canada Could Court Chinese Automakers if U.S. Talks Fail
news.summary: Prime Minister Carney signaled Canada may open the door to Chinese carmakers if trade talks with Washington keep souring, as U.S. auto tariffs threaten to climb to 50% in 2027.
news.why: Auto-parts buyers relying on cross-border USMCA flows should model a 2027 scenario with higher duties and shifting Canadian supply partners.

news.title: Are Critical Industrial Metals in for a Decade-Long Price Rise?
news.summary: A Coface study projects copper and nickel prices could roughly double over ten years as supply deficits open up by 2035.
news.why: Buyers of copper- and nickel-heavy components should consider longer-term contracts, index-linked pricing or hedges before structural shortages bite.

news.title: Steering Problem On Tanker Caused Collision In New Orleans
news.summary: Investigators point to a steering failure on the asphalt tanker that hit and capsized a moored riverboat in New Orleans last week.
news.why: Incidents on the lower Mississippi can trigger traffic restrictions, so shippers using New Orleans-area terminals should allow for short-notice delays.

news.title: Imported Goods Keep Surging Through Southern California Ports
news.summary: Inbound container volume at the Los Angeles–Long Beach complex topped one million again in October as importers keep pulling goods forward.
news.why: Strong San Pedro Bay volumes mean tighter chassis, rail and drayage capacity, so book inland moves early and watch terminal dwell times.

news.title: Three Ships Struck By Drones In Black Sea Near Romanian Shipping Canal
news.summary: Romania says drones hit three merchant vessels close to the Sulina canal, prompting fighter jets to scramble.
news.why: Expect higher war-risk premiums and possible delays for grain and bulk cargo moving through Danube and western Black Sea routes.

news.title: Borderlands Mexico: Texas cross-border traffic rises by 400 trucks through Saturday pilot
news.summary: A Saturday crossing pilot in Laredo added about 400 trucks, while U.S.-Mexico truck freight reached $75.4B in September.
news.why: Extra crossing capacity at Laredo can shorten transit for Mexico-sourced goods during peak weeks.

news.title: Spot rates jump ahead of holidays
news.summary: Truckload spot rates are climbing earlier than usual this season, raising questions about whether shipper strategies contributed.
news.why: Lock in contract capacity for late-November loads now; spot exposure is getting expensive.

news.title: Taiwan's Foxconn Bullish on Outlook But Warns About Supply Chain Tightness
news.summary: Foxconn is optimistic about demand but flags industry-wide shortages in chips, memory and certain key components.
news.why: Electronics buyers should confirm component allocations and lead times for Q1 builds now.

news.title: South Africa's Auto Industry Threatened By Worsening Port Delays
news.summary: Congestion at Durban's main container terminal is putting growing strain on South Africa's automotive sector.
news.why: Shipments via Durban need extra lead time; consider alternative South African gateways.

news.title: Oil Tanker On Fire After Hitting Mine In Hormuz
news.summary: Iranian sources say a tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine in the eastern Strait of Hormuz; the report was not independently verified.
news.why: Gulf security incidents feed directly into war-risk insurance premiums and bunker costs.

news.title: Trump To Extend Shipping Waiver For Oil, Fertilizer For 90 Days
news.summary: A 90-day extension lets foreign-flagged vessels keep carrying oil and other commodities between U.S. ports.
news.why: Extra domestic tanker capacity should help steady fuel and fertilizer delivered costs for U.S. buyers through the winter.

news.title: MSC Nears Deal To Buy Majority Stake In German Shipyard Meyer Werft
news.summary: German authorities are close to an agreement that would let MSC acquire roughly 80% of the Meyer Werft shipyard.
news.why: MSC keeps widening its reach across shipping and shipbuilding, which further concentrates bargaining power with the largest carrier.
